name: io.github.ianderso/nara-catalog-mcp
title: NARA Catalog

environmentVariables.name: NARA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Catalog API key, requested from the National Archives Catalog API team.

environmentVariables.name: NARA_MONTHLY_CALL_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Calls per month the key allows, reported by api_budget.
